network_enforcement: The release checker makes no network request. Its Lean replay delegates to the hash-bound proof recipe, which reads only the existing pinned dependency closure and writes isolated modules under /tmp. This same-worker warm-cache check is explicitly nonrelease evidence.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: must report a fresh zero-data Lean replay, the unchanged H2/M4/R4 authority, and a blocked release verdict with AUDIT-Z and THEOREM-Z false

scope_boundary: Fail-closed current-HEAD reconciliation plus a fresh narrow trust-zero replay of the zero-data branch. It does not replay the historical validation packet as current, construct the general Leray-Hopf root, accept a predecessor receipt, or supply H0/R0, cold hermetic reproduction, complete provenance/TCB/SBOM closure, independent attestations, an independent minimal verifier, a deterministic release bundle, AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, or master acceptance.
